travelerTest.title: Discover your profile
travelerTest.subtitle: Answer a few quick questions and find out what kind of traveler you are.

questions.1: Do you prefer busy destinations full of people?
questions.2: Are museums, galleries and historical sites must-see stops on your trips?
questions.3: Would you sleep in a tent in the middle of a forest?
questions.4: What matters most in your destination?
questions.5: Do you plan every detail of the trip in advance?
questions.6: Is splurging on comfortable lodging part of the experience for you?
questions.7: How do you prefer to get around at your destination?

7_options.D: Boat, ATV, horse — the more unusual, the better

questions.8: Do you try local food even without knowing what you're eating?
questions.10: Which of these activities suits you best?

10_options.D: Chatting with locals at a bar

questions.11: Do you feel comfortable changing plans on the fly?
questions.12: Are trails, waterfalls and nature parks your kind of thing?
questions.13: What do you do on your first morning at a new destination?

13_options.A: Slow coffee in the room, no rush
13_options.B: Head straight out to explore the streets
13_options.C: Look for the first trail available
13_options.D: Meet other travelers at the hostel

questions.14: Have you ever traveled somewhere just for a festival, event or show?
questions.15: How would you describe your travel budget?

15_options.A: I save on everything to travel more often
15_options.B: Balanced spending — neither luxury nor deprivation
15_options.C: I'd rather travel less and well, without saving
15_options.D: I don't mind much, the experience is what matters

questions.16: What kind of photo do you take most on trips?

16_options.C: Moments with friends at parties and bars
16_options.D: The hotel room, the pool and room service

questions.17: Do you prefer a packed itinerary over a free day with no plans?
questions.18: What would your ideal week-long itinerary be?

18_options.A: Camping and hiking in national parks
18_options.B: City tour through historic towns and museums
18_options.C: All-inclusive beach resort, never leaving the place

questions.19: Do you like to learn about the local language and customs before traveling?
questions.20: If you could choose one type of accommodation, what would it be?

20_options.A: Hostel with a lively common area
20_options.B: Boutique hotel with unique, charming decor
20_options.C: Isolated cabin in the mountains or forest

AVENTUREIRO.descricao: You live to step out of your comfort zone! You prefer steep trails, extreme sports and off-the-beaten-path destinations. Controlled risk is part of the joy of traveling.

CULTURAL.descricao: Your luggage is packed with knowledge. You love museums, historical ruins, local food and the stories behind every place. Every trip is a lesson.

NATUREZA.descricao: For you, the best view is the one without buildings. Waterfalls, forests, wildlife and wild flora are what make a trip worthwhile.

LUXO.descricao: Comfort is non-negotiable. You prefer five-star hotels, award-winning restaurants and exclusive services. Traveling well is an art, and you take it seriously.

MOCHILEIRO.descricao: Light, free and unattached. You prefer hostels, public transport and improvised itineraries. The journey matters as much as the destination.

RELAXAMENTO.descricao: Your ideal trip has a beach, sun, a good book and zero commitments. You don't avoid attractions, but you never skip recharging your batteries.

SOCIAL.descricao: You collect friendships in every time zone. Festivals, local bars, lively hostels — anywhere you can meet new people is your kind of place.

SOLITARIO.descricao: You travel to find yourself, not to get lost in crowds. Introspection, silence and a deep connection with the place are what make a trip perfect.
